messages.text:
The T. P2 ships October 3, 2026 — so it's shipping now from our warehouse, a couple of business days out.

At 166 W it's about $12 a month at 10¢/kWh. What do you pay for power?
i just want to double check if u have ddp to ship in Serbia for this model, since u have for the newest 599$ 18th/s

No, not for the Thor P2. It's drop-shipped from our warehouse and the $379 is the unit price only — Serbian customs charges VAT and any duty on delivery, paid by you. We can't collect it at checkout or quote what they'll raise.

Shipping itself is calculated at checkout from your address. Still want me to set one up?
are u human or ai bot?

I'm Sarah, the store's AI assistant — not a person. If you'd rather talk to someone on the team, say the word and I'll put you through.

Anything else on the Thor P2 I can check for you?
ask them if they can send it as ddp because everything else i added could be ddped but not thor p2 that is actually smaller and dont see the problem
Handed to the team · Shopper asks whether the Thor P2 can ship DDP to Serbia; I can't change shipping

Asked. Georges has it and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET — the answer comes to your email.

For what it's worth, the Thor P2 is drop-shipped from the manufacturer rather than out of our own stock, which is why it sits on different terms than the BS-4. Size isn't the reason.
oh ok what else with new chip bm1373 u have from your stock with ddp ready to ship asap
Searched the catalog · BM1373 bitcoin miner in stock

BM1373 units we carry: the Thor P2, the Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s, $599.99), the Harlo B30 (30 TH/s, $899), the Nexus S1 (10 TH/s, $699) and the Harlo H15 Dual ($999).

Of those, nothing but the BS-4 is both BM1373 and ready to move for you — the S1's EU plug is out of stock, and the B30 and H15 are pre-sale drops. The B.4 is the one you were already looking at.

Want me to build that cart?
but isnt bs-4 ready to ship 31.10. not before?

You're right, and I was sloppy — the BS-4 is a presale and the date on its page is the one you get. Ships 31.10, not before.

So on BM1373 there's nothing we can send you this week. The only in-stock-now units are the BC04 ($249, 6 TH/s), which is an older chip. If you want BM1373, it's the BS-4 on 31.10 or the Thor P2.
why harlo h15 dual has bigger customs for serbia and bs-4 is only 30$ ddp + shipping but for h15 dual is like 499$
I don't want to guess at a $499 line — that's a big gap and I can't see how your checkout is calculating it. Let me get you a real answer rather than a theory.
Handed to the team · Can't explain the DDP/duties figure shown at checkout for the Harlo H15 Dual to

That's with Georges alongside your Thor P2 question. He picks both up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

What I can say honestly: the H15 is $999 against the BS-4's $599.99, so duty and VAT on it are higher — but not by $400. Something else is in that number.
